title: Prototype Protocol
author: George Moberly
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.73yhqpw

steps.title: Add SWS and Mix
steps.instruction: Add 200 μl SWS to the tube and pipette to mix.

steps.title: Incubate on Heat Block
steps.instruction: Place the tube on a 50°C heat block for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Clear Supernatant via Magnetic Stand
steps.instruction: Immediately place the tube on a magnetic stand and wait until the liquid is clear (approximately 2 minutes).

steps.title: Discard Supernatant
steps.instruction: Remove and discard all supernatant from the tube.

steps.title: Remove from Magnetic Stand
steps.instruction: Remove the tube from the magnetic stand.
